external_collaboration.evidence_quote: The Royal Society for the Prevention of Accidents (RoSPA) Awards celebrate their 70th anniversary in 2026, marking seven decades as the world’s largest and most respected health and safety awards programme. This year’s awards attracted around 2,000 entries from nearly 60 countries, reflecting global recognition in accident prevention and workplace safety.
